result_text:
A sub-landscape with a missing or unreadable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent landscape report. Its row is rendered with the link to its index page and the default landscape logo, and the other rows are unchanged. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or reproduce the failure, and I didn't add a test for this case.

The fix is in `addSubLandscapeRow` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returned `null` when the file couldn't be read, and the row code then called `.getMetadata()` on that `null`, which caused the NullPointerException. It now falls back to an empty `Metadata` when the config or its metadata is `null`. That takes the existing default-logo branch, the same one used when no logo is configured.
